{{Top|leg}}
'''Antihistamine tablets''' were a form of medication that was issued to deal with various allegens.

All purpose antihistamine tablets were recommended by the ''[[Intergalactic Passport]]'' alongside [[topical ointment]]s for combating any effects of insect bites that travelers may gain from any planets within the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]], including [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] itself.
